messages:
maya: Ceiling light literally popped off mid-standup and landed on my chair. I'm ok but globe shattered 😬 (image attached).
trent: Jesus — you good? Any cuts? :eyes: 
sam: Glad you're fine. Quick idea: prop a floor lamp and soft-sheet diffuser behind monitor for now. Don't touch the wiring.
lia: I duct-taped a cheap ring light to my curtain rod once. Command hooks + zip-tie combo worked for a week. Cat loved it though 😂
owen: Turn the breaker off before anyone touches anything. Seriously, breaker -> `BRK-12` OFF.
maya: (image: ceiling-globe-cracked.jpg)
maya: Landlord coming tomorrow but need a stopgap for calls today — lighting suggestions welcome.
nick: I have a small USB panel light. Can drop it at your door in 20. DM me buzzer code.
maya: @nick you're a hero :heart: I'll leave the door unlocked briefly.
security-bot: Safety reminder — do not attempt mains repairs. File a maintenance request: `/ticket create "Ceiling light fell - Apt 4B"` :rotating_light: 
trent: Also try Zoom's "Adjust for low light" and increase exposure a notch; hides broken-globe shadows.
lia: Poll (react): Who has a spare lamp? Add :bulb: if yes.
nick: (reacts with :bulb:)
maya: Thanks everyone — testing @trent's zoom tweak now, will post a before/after pic.
